name: LM Studio
description: Desktop app with an OpenAI-compatible server and both llama.cpp and MLX backends. Very common on Macs, and configured through the app or the lms CLI.

install.command: Download from https://lmstudio.ai and enable the local server (or: lms server start)
install.notes: Not scriptable end to end; record the app version and the backend runtime version from the app's runtime panel.

notes: The number that matters is the backend runtime version (llama.cpp build or MLX version), not just the app version. Record both: app version in engine.version, runtime in engine.build_flags.
